title: Synthetic-DataGen
summary: A Streamlit web app that lets users upload a tabular dataset and generate synthetic data by choosing among GaussianCopula, CTGAN, or TVAE models. It builds SDV metadata from the dataframe and fits the chosen SDV single-table synthesizer to produce synthetic output, running SDV directly as the core generation engine.
evidence: syn_data_gen.py:66-73 builds SingleTableMetadata and instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer, then calls synthesizer.fit(df[synth_cols])
